career_path_description: Vertical progression within Risk Management from Risk Analyst to Senior Risk Analyst, Risk Manager, Head of Risk and Chief Risk Officer; deepens market, credit, operational and liquidity risk expertise level by level.

Specialist track concentrating in operational risk, expanding into cyber risk and environmental/climate risk; values event-risk identification, event reporting and risk-appetite frameworks over people management.

career_path_name: Treasury to Liquidity Risk Lateral Move
career_path_description: Lateral path between Treasury and Liquidity Risk Management leveraging fungible skill sets; frequent movement in both directions as cash-flow, funding and liquidity-risk competencies transfer.
Vertical progression in Treasury from Treasury Analyst to Treasury Manager, Head of Treasury and Group Treasurer; builds expertise in cash flow, liquidity and investment strategy.

Vertical advisory progression from Junior Wealth Advisor to Wealth Manager, Senior Private Banker and Head of Wealth Management serving high-net-worth clients with investment, estate and tax planning.
Lateral move from Wealth Management into Business Development, reusing strong client-relationship skills to drive origination and commercial growth.
Lateral transition from Commercial Banking into Risk Management; commercial bankers with strong credit-risk understanding move into the credit-risk function.
Vertical retail-banking progression from Teller/Customer Service Officer to Relationship Manager, Branch Manager and Regional Manager.
Vertical commercial-banking credit ladder from Credit Analyst to Senior Credit Analyst, Relationship Manager and Head of Commercial Banking.
Classic investment-banking managerial ladder: Analyst to Associate, Vice President, Director and Managing Director, with increasing deal leadership and team management.
Vertical compliance progression from Compliance Analyst to Compliance Officer, Compliance Manager and Head of Compliance.
Lateral move from Compliance into Risk Officer or Internal Auditor roles, leveraging shared governance and control knowledge.
Vertical internal-audit progression from Internal Auditor to Audit Manager, Director of Internal Audit and Chief Audit Executive.
Cross-functional path leveraging internal-audit foundation in operations, risk and governance to move into Controller, CFO or Compliance Officer leadership roles.
Managerial track from Software Engineer to Tech Lead and Engineering Manager, shifting focus to people and team management of technical staff.
Specialist (individual-contributor) architecture track: Junior IT Architect to IT Architect, Senior IT Architect and Chief IT Architect; deep technical mastery instead of people management.
Specialist technical track to Distinguished Engineer: non-manager senior IC who mentors and strengthens the engineering community's technical expertise.
Cross-functional track to Risk Management IT Architect, identifying, assessing and planning for technological risks; especially critical in banking and insurance.
Vertical data ladder from Data Analyst to Senior Data Analyst, Data Scientist, Analytics Lead and Head of Data & Analytics.
Vertical Financial Planning & Analysis ladder from FP&A Analyst to Senior Analyst, FP&A Manager, Finance Director and CFO.
Vertical investment-management ladder from Investment Analyst to Senior Analyst, Portfolio Manager and Investment Fund Manager, with optional sector specialisation.
Vertical HR progression from HR Analyst to HR Business Partner, HR Manager and Head of Human Resources.
Vertical operations ladder from Operations Officer to Operations Supervisor, Operations Manager and Head of Operations.
Managerial project-delivery track from Project Coordinator to Project Manager, Senior Project Manager, Programme Manager and Head of PMO.
Cross-functional move between Risk Management and Internal Audit, reusing governance, controls and risk-appetite knowledge across both control functions.
